import sqlite_utils

db['books'].insert_all([{'id':1,'author_id':1,'title':'T'}], pk='id', foreign_keys=[('author_id','authors','id')])
db.execute('DROP TABLE books')
db['books'].create({'id':int,'author_id':int,'title':str}, pk='id')
db.execute('CREATE TABLE books2 (id integer primary key, author_id integer references authors(id) on delete cascade, title text)')
db['books2'].insert_all([{'id':1,'author_id':1,'title':'T'}])
print('before books2', db['books2'].count)
with db.atomic():
    db['authors'].transform(types={'name':str})
    print('inside books2', db['books2'].count)
print('after books2', db['books2'].count)
"
